_comment: Real stone references used to guide generation. A material is only generated when approved=true and a description exists. Set approved=true only after the reference has been reviewed against the real slab and its reuse is authorized (see public/textures/sources.json).

preto-sao-gabriel.name: Preto São Gabriel
preto-sao-gabriel.finish: polished, with a deep glossy black surface
preto-sao-gabriel.description: a near-black granite with a dense, fine-to-medium even grain; small scattered light grey and white mineral flecks of a few millimetres over the black base, occasional faint silvery glints, no veins, no directional pattern and no large inclusions.

branco-dallas.name: Branco Dallas
branco-dallas.description: a cool off-white granite with a medium-to-coarse, evenly distributed granular texture: a dense milky-white feldspar background, irregular clusters of black and dark grey mica of about 2 to 8 mm, small scattered burgundy-red garnet dots of 1 to 5 mm, and a few translucent soft-grey quartz patches; no veins, no directional flow, no beige or yellow cast.

branco-itaunas.name: Branco Itaúnas
branco-itaunas.description: a warm off-white to ivory granite with a medium-to-coarse but very low-contrast grain: translucent pale cream and glassy light-grey crystals packed closely, a faint greenish-grey tint in places, sparse tiny pinkish-red garnet dots of 1 to 2 mm and almost no dark grains; from a distance it reads as a soft, nearly uniform light surface with no veins.

quartzo-branco.name: Quartzo Branco
quartzo-branco.description: a pure, bright white engineered quartz with an almost uniform surface: only extremely faint, tiny pale-grey specks visible up close, no veins, no visible grain from a distance, no pink or yellow cast.

santa-cecilia.name: Santa Cecília
santa-cecilia.description: a warm golden-beige granite with a coarse grain: golden-ochre and yellow feldspar crystals, white and translucent grey quartz, thin black mica streaks forming a slight irregular flow, and scattered burgundy-brown garnets of 3 to 8 mm; medium contrast, no veins.

verde-ubatuba.name: Verde Ubatuba
verde-ubatuba.description: a very dark green granite that reads almost black: a dense, medium-to-coarse grain of deep bottle-green to blackish crystals, lighter olive and sage-green feldspar patches, and occasional small golden-bronze mica glints; no veins and no white flecks.

preto-absoluto.name: Preto Absoluto
preto-absoluto.description: a deep, uniform black granite with an extremely fine grain: nearly solid black, with only tiny faint grey micro-specks visible up close; from the camera it reads as a continuous black surface with no flecks, veins or pattern.

marmore-branco.name: Mármore Branco
marmore-branco.description: a white marble with a cool, slightly grey-white background, soft diffuse light-grey veins flowing diagonally in thin wavy bands, a few cloudy grey patches and faint greenish-grey traces; low contrast, no dark, black or gold veins.

branco-stelar.name: Branco Stelar
branco-stelar.description: a white engineered quartz with a bright white base densely scattered with small angular translucent glass-like chips of 2 to 10 mm in white, pale grey and very pale aqua that catch the light with a subtle sparkle; no veins.

travertino.name: Travertino
travertino.description: a warm beige cross-cut travertine in cream to light tan: a cloudy, mottled surface with lighter irregular patches, thin irregular darker-tan fissures running in random directions and tiny natural pores filled flush; NOT vein-cut, with no long parallel linear bands or stripes; no grey, no glossy shine, no strong contrast.

onix-cristal.name: Ônix Cristal
onix-cristal.description: a translucent white to ivory onyx with a crystalline, fibrous structure: milky white zones, soft grey translucent depth and thin amber to rust-orange veins running mostly vertically; luminous, glassy and delicate, never opaque or chalky.

quartzo-calacata.name: Quartzo Calacata
quartzo-calacata.description: a bright white engineered quartz with a Calacatta look: a clean, slightly cool white base crossed by fine-to-medium soft grey veins that branch and fork in thin irregular lines, a few veins slightly thicker with softly blurred edges; medium contrast, no gold, beige or black veins.

quartzo-calacata-gold.name: Quartzo Calacata Gold
quartzo-calacata-gold.description: a warm bright white engineered quartz with a Calacatta Gold look: a clean white base with sparse, long, gently flowing veins in soft grey combined with thin golden-beige to light brass-toned lines, and a few wider cloudy pale-grey veins; elegant, low-to-medium contrast, no black veins.

cafe-imperial.name: Café Imperial
cafe-imperial.description: a dark coffee-brown granite with a dense medium-to-coarse grain: deep chocolate-brown and blackish crystals packed closely, scattered smaller lighter tan and pinkish-beige grains, small black mica points and occasional tiny silvery glints; it reads as a rich, dark brown speckled surface with no veins.

travertino-romano.name: Travertino Romano
travertino-romano.description: a warm beige Roman travertine in cream, honey and light tan: soft layered bands and streaks running in one direction, with small natural pores and cavities filled flush; gently varied tone, matte, no grey, no glossy shine and no strong contrast.

nanoglass.name: Nanoglass
nanoglass.description: a pure, bright, opaque white engineered glass surface: completely uniform with no veins, no grain and no speckles, with a deep glassy polish and crisp reflections; no grey, cream or blue cast.
